plugins.name: rl-soc
plugins.description: Multi-agent SOC threat-analysis workflow using ReversingLabs Spectra Intelligence via the rl-spectra-intel CLI — no MCP server required.

plugins.name: rl-soc-install
plugins.description: Installs the rl-spectra-intel CLI in a python virtual environment. Run once before using rl-soc.

plugins.name: rl-soc-connect
plugins.description: Configures the rl-spectra-intel CLI with ReversingLabs credentials. Run after rl-soc-install and before rl-soc.
